overall_reason: Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a product landing page for a design skill): the catalogue counts in the hero (57 styles, 95 palettes, 56 font pairings) are the product's own database figures and the footer repeats them exactly, so I judge the sweep's stat_band hit (INT-007) to be the brand's own counts, but the same page gives Landing Patterns two values and pads the community section with an unsourced '500+'.

score.reason: T-FIGURE-AUDIT fails twice (INT-151 on 29 against 14 landing patterns, INT-011 on '500+ micro-SaaS founders') and T-PROOF-SOURCE fails once on the bare 'Production Ready' tick (INT-022); no Floor.

findings.where: hero stat tile 'Landing Patterns' and the Landing Patterns feature card, 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-01.png)
findings.evidence: The hero stat band shows '29 / Landing Patterns'. Two screens lower, the Landing Patterns card says '14 conversion-optimized page structures with CTA placement strategies'. The other five counts agree between the band and the footer (57, 95, 56, 24, 8); this one has two values.
findings.before: "29 Landing Patterns" and "14 conversion-optimized page structures"
findings.after: One count, taken from the shipped database, in both places
findings.why: A visitor who reads both numbers cannot tell which one the product ships, and doubts the other counts too.

findings.evidence: The intro reads 'the Next Level Builders community of 500+ micro-SaaS founders' and a card title repeats '500+ Solo Builders Network'. The claims table flags both as open-ended and round, with no source or footnote nearby, and neither links to a member list or a dated count.
findings.after: Link the directory with a dated member count, or drop the number
findings.why: The figure carries the section's trust pitch ('human-verified', 'High-Trust Verification'), yet the visitor has no way to check it.

findings.evidence: The row under 'Get on GitHub' reads '✓ Open Source  ✓ Claude Code Compatible  ✓ Production Ready'. The first two are facts a visitor can check; 'Production Ready' has no version, release date, test or adoption figure behind it anywhere on the page.
findings.after: Replace it with the checkable fact (current version and release date), or remove it
findings.why: A tick mark gives an opinion the look of a verified property.

strengths: The GitHub star count in the nav carries the GitHub mark and links to the repository, so its platform is named.
